domain_description: Comprehensive automotive engineering and diagnostics covering engine systems, transmissions, brake systems, electrical architecture, suspension, HVAC, fuel systems, emissions, hybrid/EV technology, body structure, paint coatings, tire analysis, OBD diagnostics, fleet management, and accident reconstruction per SAE, EPA, FMVSS, and ISO standards.

engines.name: Engine Diagnostics Engine
engines.function: Diagnose internal combustion engine faults using OBD-II data, sensor analysis, compression testing, and combustion analysis for gasoline and diesel powertrains.
doctrine_topics: OBD-II diagnostic trouble code (DTC) interpretation
engine sensor data analysis (MAP, MAF, O2, CKP, CMP)
compression and leak-down test interpretation
fuel trim analysis (STFT, LTFT) for mixture diagnosis
ignition system diagnostics (coil, spark, timing)
diesel common rail injection system analysis
engine misfire diagnosis and cylinder contribution
variable valve timing system diagnostics
turbocharger and supercharger fault diagnosis
engine oil analysis and wear metal interpretation

golden_queries.question: A 2020 Ford F-150 3.5L EcoBoost shows P0300 random misfire with LTFT Bank 1 at +18% and Bank 2 at +2%. Diagnose the root cause using OBD-II data and recommend the diagnostic pathway

engines.name: Transmission Analysis Engine
engines.function: Diagnose and analyze automatic, manual, CVT, and dual-clutch transmission systems including shift quality, torque converter performance, and clutch pack analysis.
doctrine_topics: automatic transmission shift quality analysis
torque converter lockup and stall speed diagnostics
CVT belt/chain and pulley ratio analysis
dual-clutch transmission engagement diagnostics
transmission fluid analysis and condition assessment
solenoid and valve body diagnostics
gear ratio verification and speed sensor analysis
transmission adaptive learning and reset procedures
manual transmission synchronizer wear diagnosis
transfer case and AWD system diagnostics

golden_queries.question: A 10-speed automatic transmission exhibits harsh 3-4 upshift and 4-3 downshift flare at operating temperature. Analyze possible causes using line pressure data, solenoid duty cycles, and clutch pack engagement timing

engines.name: Brake Systems Engine

doctrine_topics: hydraulic brake system analysis and troubleshooting

FMVSS 135 stopping distance requirements
brake thermal analysis and fade conditions

golden_queries.question: A vehicle with ESC shows intermittent activation during straight-line driving on dry pavement, with ABS module DTCs C0035 and C0040. Diagnose the system using wheel speed sensor data and yaw rate sensor comparison

engines.name: Electrical Systems Engine

golden_queries.question: A vehicle has a 350mA parasitic draw causing overnight battery drain. Describe the systematic diagnostic process using current clamp measurement, fuse pulling methodology, and module wake-up analysis on CAN bus

engines.name: Suspension Engine

engines.name: Automotive HVAC Engine

doctrine_topics: automotive A/C system pressure analysis and charging

golden_queries.question: An EV heat pump system provides inadequate heating below 20F ambient. Analyze the system using refrigerant pressures, compressor current draw, and supplemental PTC heater activation to diagnose the performance limitation
required_elements: heat pump COP analysis at low ambient

engines.name: Fuel Systems Engine
